# Commit Message Guidelines

## Format Structure
```
<type>(<scope>): <emoji> <brief description>

<detailed body explaining what and why>

autogenerated by copilot
```

## Writing Effective Descriptions

### Brief Description (50 chars max)

- Use imperative mood: "Add feature" not "Added feature"
- Be specific: "Fix user login validation" not "Fix bug"

### Detailed Body

**Always include:**

- **Files changed**: List specific files modified
- **Reasoning**: Why this change was necessary
- **Impact**: What behavior changes for users/developers

### Example

```
feat(auth): :sparkles: Add password reset functionality

Files changed:

- src/auth/password_reset.py: New password reset handler
- templates/reset_form.html: User interface for reset requests
- tests/test_auth.py: Unit tests for reset flow

Added secure password reset via email tokens to improve user 
experience when users forget credentials. Implements 15-minute 
token expiration and rate limiting to prevent abuse.

autogenerated by copilot
```

## Quick Checklist

- [ ] Appropriate emoji used
- [ ] Brief description under 50 characters
- [ ] All modified files listed
- [ ] Clear explanation of why change was made
- [ ] "autogenerated by copilot" included

## Emoji Guide

- :sparkles: for new features
- :bug: for bug fixes
- :memo: for documentation changes
- :lipstick: for UI changes
- :recycle: for refactoring
- :wrench: for configuration changes
- :fire: for removing code or files
- :green_heart: for CI/CD improvements
- :lock: for security fixes
- :arrow_up: for upgrades
- :arrow_down: for downgrades
- :heavy_plus_sign: for adding dependencies
- :heavy_minus_sign: for removing dependencies
- :construction: for work in progress
- :rocket: for performance improvements
- :art: for improving structure/formatting
- :tada: for initial commit
- :package: for packaging changes
- :chart_with_upwards_trend: for analytics improvements
- :chart_with_downwards_trend: for analytics downgrades
- :bulb: for new ideas or concepts
